stories.headline: U.S. Army Selects Carlyle and CyrusOne to Build Hyperscale Data Centers on Military Land

key_facts.fact: Carlyle was selected for a project on 1,384 acres at Fort Bliss, Texas, with Initial Operating Capability targeted for FY 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Global Investment Firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) was selected for a project on about 1,384 acres at Fort Bliss, Texas

key_facts.fact: CyrusOne, owned by KKR and BlackRock, was selected for a project on 1,201 acres at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, with IOC targeted for FY 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: CyrusOne, a portfolio company jointly held by funds managed by KKR and BlackRock, was selected for a project on approximately 1,201 acres at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah

key_facts.fact: The companies will finance, build, operate, maintain, and decommission the data centers at no cost to taxpayers under the Enhanced Use Lease program.
key_facts.excerpt: companies finance, build, operate, maintain, and decommission... Enhanced Use Lease program authorized under Title 10 U.S. Code § 2667

key_facts.fact: Secretary of the Army Dan Driscoll called AI 'a strategic asset for the Army' that 'generates resiliency across the force.'
key_facts.excerpt: AI is a strategic asset for the Army...generates resiliency across the force

key_facts.fact: The initiative aligns with the White House's 2025 executive order on accelerating federal data center permitting.
key_facts.excerpt: Aligns with White House's 2025 executive order on accelerating federal data center permitting

sources.title: Army reaches conditional agreement with private industry for hyperscaled data centers

stories.headline: Joliet Approves $20 Billion, 1.8GW Data Center Campus on 795 Acres

key_facts.fact: PowerHouse Data Centers and Hillwood Holding are developing the $20 billion Joliet Technology Center on 795 acres in Will County, Illinois.
key_facts.excerpt: PowerHouse Data Centers and Hillwood Holding... 795-acre development represents a staggering $20 billion investment

key_facts.fact: The campus will have 1.8 gigawatts of power capacity across 24 two-story buildings spanning 3.5 million square feet, with four dedicated six-acre substations.
key_facts.excerpt: 1.8 gigawatts... 24 two-story structures spanning 3.5 million square feet total. Four dedicated six-acre substations

key_facts.fact: The project will proceed in four phases without public incentives or tax abatements, and could generate $310 million to $2.1 billion in city tax revenue over 30 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Four-phase rollout... without the traditional safety net of public incentives or tax abatements... $310 million to $2.1 billion in tax revenue over 30 years

key_facts.fact: The project will create thousands of construction jobs across the multi-phase buildout on land 40 miles southwest of Chicago.
key_facts.excerpt: 40 miles southwest of Chicago... thousands of high-paying construction roles throughout the multi-phase buildout

sources.title: Joliet Approves Massive $20 Billion Data Center Project

stories.headline: Intel Launches Arc Pro B70 and B65 GPUs With 32GB and 367 TOPS for AI Workstations

key_facts.fact: The Arc Pro B70 features 32 Xe cores, 256 XMX engines, 367 peak INT8 TOPS, and 32GB GDDR6 with 608 GB/s bandwidth on the Big Battlemage BMG-G31 architecture.
key_facts.excerpt: 32 Xe cores, 32 ray tracing units... 367 TOPS for INT8 (non-sparse) precision... 32GB GDDR6... 608GB/second

key_facts.fact: The B70 is priced at $949 and ships next week from Newegg, while the B65 with 20 Xe cores is expected in mid-April.
key_facts.excerpt: B70: $949 (reference); ships next Thursday from Newegg. B65: Price TBD by AIBs; expected mid-April availability

key_facts.fact: Four Arc Pro B70 cards can pool 128GB of VRAM, which Intel says is the threshold for running larger versions of several inference models.
key_facts.excerpt: Four cards pool 128GB—the magic number for running the larger version of several inference models

key_facts.fact: Intel claims the B70 delivers up to 2.2x larger context windows, 6.2x faster responses in multi-agent workloads, and 2x tokens per dollar versus competition.
key_facts.excerpt: up to 2.2x larger context windows versus the competition... up to 6.2x faster responses in multi-agent/multi-user workloads, as well as up to 2x tokens per dollar performance

key_facts.fact: Both GPUs are built on Intel's Xe2 architecture with board power ranging from 160W to 290W, and Intel's own B70 variant rated at 230W.
key_facts.excerpt: Both GPUs are built on Intel's Xe2 architecture, offering up to 32Xe cores, 32GB of GDDR6 VRAM, 367 peak TOPS, and 608 GB/s of memory bandwidth. Board power ranges from 160W to 290W, with Intel's own-branded card rated at 230W

sources.title: Intel Announces Arc Pro B70 and B65 Video Cards: Big Battlemage Brings Big Memory for AI Workstations

stories.headline: AMD Announces Ryzen 9 9950X3D2, World's First Dual 3D V-Cache CPU With 208MB Cache

key_facts.fact: The Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 is the first-ever PC processor with two chiplets both powered by AMD 3D V-Cache technology, delivering 208MB of total cache (192MB L3).
key_facts.excerpt: It's the first-ever PC processor to provide two chiplets, both powered by AMD 3D V-Cache technology. And it's the most powerful AMD PC processor yet, the first to offer 16 Zen 5 cores and 208 MB of total cache

key_facts.fact: The chip has 16 Zen 5 cores, 32 threads, a 4.3GHz base clock, 5.6GHz boost clock, and a 200W TDP on TSMC 4nm.
key_facts.excerpt: 16 Zen 5 cores and 208MB of total cache... Max. Boost Clock - Up to 5.6 GHz, Base Clock - 4.3 GHz... Default TDP - 200W, Processor Technology for CPU Cores - TSMC 4nm FinFET

key_facts.fact: AMD claims 5-10% performance gains over the current Ryzen 9 9950X3D in creative workloads like DaVinci Resolve, Blender, and large-scale code builds.
key_facts.excerpt: a 5 to 10 percent performance boost over the current Ryzen 9 9950X3D across DaVinci Resolve, Blender, and other creative workloads, and large-scale source code builds like Unreal Engine and Chromium

key_facts.fact: The processor will be available worldwide on April 22, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 will be available worldwide on April 22

key_facts.fact: Each X3D-boosted CCD has 64MB of 3D V-Cache and 32MB of on-CCD cache, with the boost clock reduced by 100 MHz vs. the 9950X3D due to the dual-stack power requirements.
key_facts.excerpt: the boost clock sees a 100 MHz reduction, which may be due to the fact that the separate X3D cache requires more power

sources.title: AMD Unleashes Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition, The World's First CPU With Dual 3D V-Cache
AMD announced the Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition processor

stories.headline: Uber, Pony.ai, and Verne Partner to Launch Europe's First Commercial Robotaxi in Zagreb

key_facts.fact: Verne, Pony.ai, and Uber announced a strategic partnership to launch the first commercial robotaxi service in Europe, beginning in Zagreb, Croatia.
key_facts.excerpt: today announced a strategic partnership to launch the first commercial robotaxi service in Europe, beginning in Zagreb soon

key_facts.fact: The service uses Arcfox Alpha T5 vehicles powered by Pony.ai's Gen-7 autonomous driving system, with on-road testing already underway in Zagreb.
key_facts.excerpt: They're using Arcfox Alpha T5 vehicles made by Beijing-based automaker BAIC Motor powered by Pony.ai's Gen-7 autonomous driving system

key_facts.fact: Pony.ai provides autonomous driving technology, Verne handles fleet ownership and operations, and Uber integrates the service into its ride-hailing platform.
key_facts.excerpt: Pony.ai will provide autonomous driving solutions, while Verne will act as the fleet owner and service operator

key_facts.fact: The three companies plan to expand the fleet to thousands of robotaxis across European cities over the next few years.
key_facts.excerpt: The three companies plan to expand the fleet to thousands of robotaxis in European cities over the next few years

stories.headline: SpaceX Launches 25 Starlink Satellites From Vandenberg in Base's 20th Liftoff of 2026

key_facts.fact: SpaceX launched 25 Starlink satellites on the Starlink 17-17 mission from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base on March 26 at 4:03 PM PDT.
key_facts.excerpt: The Starlink 17-17 mission lifts off from Vandenberg Space Force Base

key_facts.fact: Booster B1081 completed its 23rd flight, continuing SpaceX's record of rapid booster reuse.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX Launches Satellites from Vandenberg, Marking Base's 20th Liftoff of 2026

key_facts.fact: The launch marked Vandenberg Space Force Base's 20th liftoff of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Marking Base's 20th Liftoff of 2026

key_facts.fact: The mission was originally scheduled for March 24 but was delayed two days for undisclosed reasons.
key_facts.outlet: Vandenberg Space Force Base on X

stories.headline: Google Announces Botetourt County Data Center Campus Powered by Virginia's First Wind Farm

key_facts.fact: Google formally announced plans to develop a multi-building data center campus in Botetourt County, Virginia, committing to fund all energy and infrastructure costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Google has formally announced plans to develop a data center campus in Botetourt County, centered on what it calls a commitment to responsibly build digital infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Google signed a Power Purchase Agreement for the full output of the Rocky Forge Wind project (79.3 MW), Virginia's first utility-scale wind facility being built in northern Botetourt County.
key_facts.excerpt: Google said it has entered into an agreement to purchase the output of the Rocky Forge Wind project, which is being built in northern Botetourt County

key_facts.fact: Each data center building at the campus is projected to use 2 million gallons of water per day for cooling, sourced under existing regulatory requirements.
key_facts.excerpt: any water use – projected at 2 million gallons per day per each data center building at the Botetourt campus – would be pursued under existing regulatory requirements

key_facts.fact: Google is partnering with the Western Virginia Water Authority to explore cooling options and funding expansion of Virginia Tech's reservoir monitoring.
key_facts.excerpt: working closely with the Western Virginia Water Authority to explore multiple options for cooling at the site

sources.title: Google has formally announced plans to develop a data center campus in Botetourt County
